decisions.reason: The power-input modification does not change the signal interface; the separate signal connector and pinout stated in the same message are already captured by the candidate's own MODIFY.
The candidate's existing same-message MODIFY already includes the exact four-pin JST-PH power input and its 5V/GND/3V3/GND pinout.
Specifying the sensor-board power connector does not alter I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, or cable-length conditioning.
The sensor-board power connector type and pinout do not change any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment.
The sensor-board power connection is independent of the native USB D+ and D- programming interface.
The sensor-board interboard power connector is distinct from the battery's JST-PH connector and does not resolve or alter the battery pin-order ambiguity.
The source power-interface change does not alter the SPS30 SEL-to-GND connection or its I2C operating mode; those details are an independent clause of the message.
The panel reset connector and EN-to-GND behavior are unaffected by the sensor-board power input specification.
Providing 5V and 3V3 on the sensor-board power input does not change the addressable LED supply, level-shifter, or rail-shutdown requirements.
The PIR connector requirement remains unchanged by the sensor-board interboard power connector specification.
The panel button and switch connector mappings are unrelated to the sensor-board power input.
The detailed sensor-board power input is consistent with the existing three-board architecture and sensor-connector-board role without changing either architectural attribute.
